title: Clackety Curio Crab
statement: Nestled in a sun-dappled kelp grotto strewn with tumbled sea glass, this bustling little decorator crab meticulously adorns its carapace with glowing pebbles, tiny brass gears, and spiral shells. Whenever a visitor peers into the tank, it taps a cheerful rhythm with its claws and rearranges its shimmering treasures into an entirely new constellation.
